The Village of Olympia Fields and Matteson are served by the Matteson Volunteer Fire Department. Lincoln Highway is an important access route, particularly to homes in the western portion of the improvement where there is presently little or no access from a southerly direction. A second fire station to serve this westerly area has been proposed for a site on Kostner Avenue south from Lincoln Highway and adjacent to a proposed shopping center.
F. Summary of Technical, Social, and Economic Studies made to Support the Proposed Action
The following is a list of the technical, social, and economic studies made or used in the planning of the improvement. These studies are mentioned in more depth in their appropriate sections of this statement.
1. Traffic volumes on Lincoln Highway, present and projected, conducted by the Illinois Department of Transportation.
   Accident Rates for Lincoln Highway gleaned from State of Illinois Computer Bank records of accident reports files by local, state, and county police.
   Noise studies conducted by Illinois Department of Transportation.
4. Air pollution study conducted by the Illinois Department of Transportation
5. Population, Employment, and Land Use Forecasts for Counties and Townships in Northeastern Illinois prepared by the Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission.
6. Water Quality Network 1971, Summary of Data, prepared by the State of Illinois Environmental Protection Agency.
7. The Suburban Factbook 1973, prepared by the Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission.
8. Geology of the Chicago Region, Bulletin No. 65, Part I by J. Harlen Bretz, State Geological Survey, Printed by authority of the State of Illinois, 1939.
9. Summary of the Geology of the Chicago Area by H.B. William, Illinois State Geological Survey, Circular No. 460, 1971.
